revision_reason: Audit corrected file layout; accurately name all pair candidates and preserve SHA-based relocation trace

configuration.pairing: adjacent plus non-adjacent exact-exposure metadata matches within each folder; alternatives overlap, not independent
configuration.crops: three 256x256 central-height mosaic squares at x=20/50/80%
configuration.noise_variance: sample variance of (A-B)/sqrt(2), no bias subtraction needed for this statistic
configuration.saturation_reference: >=98% of rawpy.white_level; conservative near-white exclusion, not a certified clipping threshold
configuration.dark_like: all 12 ROI/plane means differ by <=max(1% median,8DN); not proof of cap-on capture
